hook: Every death feeds your Compost pile, and where you place your Fruits decides who feasts on it next turn.
loop: Order your Fruits and sell or bury spares for Compost.
Fight deaths pile up Compost; Spores refill gaps to keep runs touching.
Start of Turn, Fruits spend it in lumps for permanent stats.

growth.line: Small Fruit gains from turn 2; Puffwell's +2/+2 to all at Tier 5, doubled by Bootlace.

feel.early: Small Fruits grow; cheap units die for Compost.
feel.mid: Making change: order Fruits, refill gaps with Spores.
feel.late: Puffwell and Bootlace pour stats across the board.

stars.why: Its slot decides which Fruits get paid first.
Tier 1 seed that pays a bonus for exact change.
Buries a unit at Start of Combat, setting off every death card.

card_short.u02: Fruit 2: grows itself, more on exact change.
card_short.u03: Sold units pay Compost equal to their tier, not gold.
card_short.u04: Grows when touching units die, twice a fight.
card_short.u05: Fruit 3: permanently buffs the units beside it.
card_short.u06: When played, buries a neighbour for 4 Compost.
card_short.u07: Touching units that die leave a Spore in their slot.
card_short.u08: Touching units' deaths deal 2 damage to the enemy across.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: buffs its touching run by Compost held.
card_short.u10: Fruit 3: gain 2 gold, losing Health until it dies.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: the pile grows with interest.
card_short.u12: Front-row deaths permanently grow a unit behind.
card_short.u13: Start of Combat: kills your weakest; neighbours take its stats.
card_short.u14: Fruit 6, repeating: all your other units get +2/+2.
card_short.u15: Mid-fight: 2 Compost turns a death into a 4/4 Spore.
card_short.u17: Every paid Fruit fires twice, the second free.
card_short.u18: Each death buffs this and its touching run, this fight.
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: your board gains +1/+1 per 2 Compost.
card_short.x01: A 1/1 token; most vanish after the fight.

builds.name: Harvest Table
builds.line: Button, Pallbearer, Puffwell and Bootlace; order Fruits so nothing goes unspent.

builds.name: The Wake
builds.line: Front row dies, Spores keep the run whole, back row fattens.

builds.name: The Long Mourning
builds.line: Hoard Compost; Lantern-bearer and Ashcake turn the pile into fight stats.

liked: All three picked Puffwell: where you place him decides the turn's spending.
Fruits paying in reading order is a fresh placement puzzle, all three said.
worries: Watch: Puffwell with Hired Mute, Mourner and Bootlace turns gold into uncapped stats.
Watch: Inkcap beside Pallbearer pays gold forever; Ashcake's +6/+6 strong early Tier 6.
changed: Button Mushroom now grows double when it spends your last Compost.
Lantern-bearer now buffs its touching run, smaller: per 4 Compost, up to +2/+2.
Clearer wording on Amanita, Bootlace, Old Fingers and Abbess; Inkcap now dies at 0.
verdict: Fun 6.7, distinct 6.7, third of three Rot Guild designs: a clever puzzle, more sums than growth; for fans of placement puzzles.
